courses.title: David Silver: Reinforcement Learning (UCL, 2015)
courses.blurb: It was on this repo's first list, in 2016, and it's still a good place to start. Ten lectures, from MDPs to classic games.

courses.title: Berkeley CS 285: Deep Reinforcement Learning (Fall 2023)
courses.blurb: Sergey Levine's course, the current version of the CS 294 course in the 2017 notes. Imitation learning, policy gradients, Q-learning, model-based and offline RL, and RL with language models.
